 Copied! 
 The San Francisco 49ers will travel to Dallas to face the Cowboys in Week 10 of the 2026 regular season at AT&T Stadium. The matchup is set to kick off at 1:25 p.m. PT on Sunday, November 15th. Here are all the ways to follow the game, presented by Visa.
 HOW TO WATCH
 Stream the game FOX
 Fans in the Bay Area can watch the game on FOX 2 KTVU television.
 NFL+ : Watch live local, primetime, regular season, and postseason games on your phone or tablet, game replays, and more.
 Watch internationally Fans in Mexico can watch the game live on Canal 9.
 Fans in the UK can watch the game live on Sky Sports NFL and Channel 5.
 Fans in the UK, UAE, Mexico, and across international markets can watch every live NFL game on Game Pass International on DAZN .
 For more ways to watch, click here .
 HOW TO LISTEN
 U.S. Bank 49ers Radio Network All 49ers games can be heard on KSAN (107.7 FM "The Bone") and KNBR (104.5 FM/680 AM) and the 49ers Radio Network.
 Fans can also listen live on the 49ers App or on 49ers.com .
 Spanish Radio Network The live game broadcast featuring announcers Jesús Zárate and Carlos Yustis will be streamed at no cost to fans exclusively on the 49ers App or at 49ers.com/esp . To view all of the team's Spanish content, please click here .
 Mexico Broadcast The Week 10 game will be broadcast on radio via W Deportes 730 AM.
 UK Broadcast The Week 10 game will be broadcast via talkSPORT Radio.
 For more ways to listen, click here .
